name: Ms. Sadie
aliases: the old woman with the gray hair
description: An old woman who took Maeli in and burst into many arms at dinner.

timeline.summary: Ms. Sadie's chest bursts open into many arms at dinner and she chases Maeli.
timeline.quote: the same writhing arms that had burst out of Ms. Sadie's chest that very night while they ate their dinner

timeline.summary: The cathars slice off Ms. Sadie's grasping arms.
timeline.quote: The cathars shifted in the tall grass, slicing off one arm after another.

relations.note: She took him in before transforming and chasing him.
relations.quote: She had told him to call her Ms. Sadie, and said that her house could be his house for as long as he wanted.

pages_say.description: An old woman who took Maeli in and burst into many arms at dinner.
